newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel head says Q1 sales show recovery.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel head says Q1 sales show recovery.

text.p: Alcatel Alsthom SA chairman Serge Tchuruk said on Tuesday a 12.1 percent rise in first quarter sales showed the company was on the road to recovery.
Speaking at a news conference Tchuruk said, "It shows we are on the road to recovery. There's still a long way to go but we are on the right track."
Tchuruk added that the 10 percent rise in telecoms orders in the first quarter was important for the company.
Alcatel shares climbed more than five percent after the first quarter sales figures were released earlier on Tuesday.
Tchuruk said he was surprised that the market always reacted so heavily when Alcatel delivered what it had promised it would do.
